fields.statement: Each reader-column fragment builder call (ReaderStringExpressions, ReaderEnumXIntExpressions, ReaderSimpleValueExpressions, ReaderNullableValueTypeExpressions) appends exactly one column-ordinal lookup to columnLookupExpressions, reads its own ordinal back from the ordinals array at the current value of the shared ref propIndex counter, and increments that counter by exactly one: within a single call, the lookup append and the counter increment always occur together, and neither happens without the other.
fields.scope: ExpressionHelpers reader-column fragment builders, within a single compiled reader-mapping delegate build
